BiblicalUsage: Asiel is named once, among the princes of Simeon listed in the tribal record. He stands in the genealogy as one of the leaders of his father's house.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the chronicler kept these names because every family and every leader counted in Israel's story, even when their deeds are not told.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
